data.narrative:
Neko Health is a Series C biotech company founded by Daniel Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne that has raised $326M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 3 public companies (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in Biotech & Health, with particular focus on 3 same-stage private comparables: Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), and New Limit ($3.1B).

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-Progression analysis uses the $400M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier, implying $680M. Peer-Median analysis across the 3 same-sector, same-stage private companies yields a median of $3.8B, with a range of $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-Comp Anchoring cannot be applied given the absence of disclosed revenue figures. The wide dispersion among private peers ($3.1B–$10.3B) reflects meaningful uncertainty in biotech valuations at this stage.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $578M (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $2.2B. The gap between stage-progression and peer-median results highlights key uncertainty around where Neko Health sits relative to its peer cohort on clinical progress, market opportunity, and capital efficiency. Revenue trajectory and clinical milestones would be primary value drivers within this range.
